brief.head: Modern chase cards and sealed both slip this week
brief.body: The Chase 100 is down 2.6% this week at $29,464, and Modern Sealed 100 is down 0.8%. Biggest jump today: Trunks : Future - SB02-011 (Manga Booster 02 Release Event Cards), up 210% to $17.48. 117 cards worth $10+ show steady week-long gains, 590 are cooling off.

graded.basis: Modern Pokémon cards where a PSA 10 pays off best and sells at least weekly. Assumes raw at the lowest listing, PSA Standard grading ($59.99, plus upcharges when a grade is worth more than the tier covers), $15 shipping, eBay selling fees, and 30% odds of a 10 and 50% of a 9.
